predictions.statement: A material late distal interaction contribution remains in the matched-state zero-command drift solve.
predictions.estimand: Late event-window distal-interface drift work and cancellation-stable drift share.
predictions.intervention: Evaluate total, zero-command drift, and commanded increment at identical achieved states, then execute a branched zero-command rollout.
predictions.expected_result: Late drift work is positive and the branched response persists beyond the numerical convergence interval.
predictions.falsifier: The contribution fails component closure, becomes non-positive after passive/base/shaft terms are inventoried, or disappears within the convergence-calibrated interval.
negative_controls: hold shaft elasticity at its matched rigid limit
predictions.status_scope: Branched persistence is supported through the declared reduced two-engine spatial forward-contact tier; the complete formal decomposition is available only in lower tiers.
predictions.remaining_gate: Repeat the formal drift/control ledger in a closed-contact subject-scaled articulated spatial model and then in participant-held-out data.

predictions.statement: Interaction transfer changes sign with force-velocity alignment and contact moment-arm geometry rather than force magnitude alone.
predictions.estimand: Interface wrench power and equivalent club couple under registered geometry interventions.
predictions.intervention: Reverse the registered path projection or contact moment arm while holding the force norm and declared state inventory fixed.
predictions.expected_result: The corresponding power or equivalent-couple contribution reverses sign within the registered event neighborhood.
predictions.falsifier: The predicted sign response does not occur, depends on a reference-frame artifact, or fails at the next model tier under the same observable definition.
negative_controls: properly rotate the complete wrench and twist together
transport wrench and twist to a second reference point
predictions.status_scope: Geometry sign, null, frame, and reference-transport responses are supported through reduced spatial tiers. All 234 registered subject-scaled configurations close, and selected-state articulated distributed-grip, shaft, and ground atlases execute under independent native engines. A deterministic preflight binds 83 feasible structural-corner headline states plus one retained failure to exact atlas designs and hashes; propagation and human calibration remain open.
predictions.remaining_gate: Repeat the geometry interventions through every feasible exact scaled authority in both native-engine headline atlases, retain registered structural failures, and test held-out human wrenches.

predictions.statement: A late negative club couple persists without simultaneous commanded distal torque in a nonsingular forward two-hand model.
predictions.estimand: Equivalent club couple and club angular work after a registered distal-torque killswitch.
predictions.intervention: Branch the forward constrained trajectory at preregistered cut events and set distal commands to zero without changing state or contact mode.
predictions.expected_result: A negative force-generated club couple persists for a nonzero convergence-resolved horizon.
predictions.falsifier: The couple vanishes, changes sign, requires singular contact allocation, or is accounted for by omitted active, passive, shaft, or stabilization terms.
negative_controls: remove the relevant contact moment arm
swap lead and trail contact geometry
repeat with independent constraint stabilization settings
predictions.status_scope: Finite post-killswitch negative force-generated couple is supported in the declared planar and reduced spatial forward-contact models.
predictions.remaining_gate: Repeat the same-state negative-couple inventory across the exact scaled articulated authorities with calibrated grip contact, distributed shaft dynamics, and governed human measurements.

predictions.statement: Anticipatory opposing commands can improve a declared delivery objective when actuator delay overlaps the drift-force reversal.
predictions.estimand: Held-out club delivery objective under matched actuator cost, joint-load, and command-rate constraints.
predictions.intervention: Compare delayed reactive, preview, and robust controllers in forward dynamics with matched feasible effort proxies.
predictions.expected_result: Preview control improves the preregistered held-out objective without exceeding matched loading and actuator constraints.
predictions.falsifier: The benefit disappears under forward activation dynamics, matched constraints, uncertainty, or held-out trajectories.
negative_controls: shuffle reversal-event timing within the admissible window
predictions.status_scope: A preselected opposing-command program improves lower-tail delivery speed in the declared held-out synthetic ensemble, with objective and load tradeoffs retained.
predictions.remaining_gate: Test physiological activation, co-contraction, subject-scaled capacity, independently identified delays, and participant-held-out outcomes.

predictions.statement: The qualitative intervention response survives transport from planar open chains to constrained moving-base and 3-D full-body models.
predictions.estimand: Registered sign, event ordering, work partition, and intervention-response equivalence metrics across model tiers and engines.
predictions.intervention: Replay the same registered mechanism experiment through each supported model adapter and independent engine.
predictions.expected_result: Every preregistered qualitative response remains inside its preoutcome equivalence region or is explicitly classified as a structural discrepancy.
predictions.falsifier: A higher tier or independent engine contradicts a registered response outside the calibrated numerical and parameter uncertainty bounds.
predictions.status_scope: Qualitative controls transport through reduced planar, spatial, and declared selected-state articulated tiers. Six of seven registered structural corners retain 52/52 feasible states; the low-height corner retains one IK nonconvergence. A deterministic preflight binds 83 feasible headline states and the retained failure, but corner-wise headline propagation remains open.
predictions.remaining_gate: Propagate every feasible exact scaled authority through both native-engine shaft and finite-ground atlases with reversal, refinement, pathway killswitches, and unchanged matching controls before claiming structural robustness; calibrated human transport remains untested.

predictions.statement: Matched net club moment can be allocated between direct wrist moment and a force-generated bilateral grip couple, but preload and transmission history can make the allocations dynamically nonequivalent.
predictions.estimand: Matched club moment, wrist moment, grip couple, hand load, generalized effort, transmission continuity, and delivery outcome.
predictions.intervention: Compare proximal push-pull and direct-wrist allocation extremes under the same club angular task, then exchange their preload and downswing roles under matched state, work, and load constraints.
predictions.expected_result: The algebraic moment closes for every allocation and at least one transmission observable changes with preload or delay without violating the matched task.
predictions.falsifier: Moment closure fails, the allocations cannot realize the same task, or all proposed transmission differences vanish under matched state, work, load, and held-out evaluation.
competing_explanations: continuous elasticity rather than a dead zone
predictions.status_scope: Allocation closure and history-sensitive transmission are supported only in the declared matched-task and phenomenological model families; no preferred human allocation is identified.
predictions.remaining_gate: Execute bilateral grip-wrench, pressure, stiffness, delay, EMG, and participant-held-out tests with closed-chain inverse dynamics.

predictions.statement: A complete wrench and compatible twist preserve interface power under proper frame rotation and reference-point transport, and canonical pose adapters preserve their declared pose coordinates.
predictions.estimand: Frame- and reference-transport power residual plus canonical-pose adapter round-trip error.
predictions.intervention: Rotate and transport paired wrenches and twists, then encode and decode one registered nonzero pose through every available adapter.
predictions.expected_result: Power closes within tolerance and every declared pose coordinate round-trips without convention-dependent sign or ordering changes.
predictions.falsifier: Power changes under a proper paired transform, virtual work fails, or an adapter changes a registered coordinate outside tolerance.
negative_controls: transport both fields to a second point
predictions.status_scope: The executed mathematical invariants and five pose-adapter round trips pass; five-engine dynamic-state, contact, wrench, event, and trajectory parity remain untested.
predictions.remaining_gate: Replay one model-hash-bound dynamic trajectory with common events, wrenches, moments, power, and residuals in every available backend.

predictions.statement: The same net joint moment admits multiple agonist-antagonist allocations, and activation plus series-force history can leave different internal states under the same instantaneous moment.
predictions.estimand: Matched net moment, activation allocation, muscle-force state, stiffness proxy, series energy, and history-transition error.
predictions.intervention: Enumerate matched-moment recruitment families and compare persistent versus reversing activation histories in the reduced Hill-type bridge.
predictions.expected_result: Multiple allocations reproduce the task while internal activation, force, stiffness, or series-energy states remain distinct.
predictions.falsifier: The matched-moment family collapses to one allocation or all internal history differences disappear under the registered dynamics and tolerances.
predictions.status_scope: Reduced identifiability and state-history demonstrations pass for generic constant-moment-arm muscle surrogates; anatomy, physiology, performance, and human strategy remain untested.
predictions.remaining_gate: Run subject-scaled OpenSim feasibility families and MyoSuite forward replay against synchronized bilateral wrench, motion, shaft, EMG, and held-out participant data.

predictions.statement: A delayed and noisy state-relative handoff provides a wider robust timing region and more sustained recovery than a clock-triggered handoff under matched task, load, and effort guards.
predictions.estimand: Common-phase task-viable fraction, contiguous timing width, sustained recovery, delivery, load, effort, and numerical residual.
predictions.intervention: Compare clock and delayed-noisy state triggers on common nominal phase offsets, load cohorts, and paired trajectory perturbations.
predictions.expected_result: The state trigger retains a larger viable phase region and a recovery-qualified subset without hidden load or effort increase.
predictions.falsifier: The clock policy has equal or larger viable width, the state-trigger advantage disappears under paired controls, or neither policy exhibits sustained recovery.
negative_controls: matched task, load, and effort guards
predictions.status_scope: The registered planar common-phase screen gives the clock policy the larger viable region, and neither policy has a sustained-recovery-qualified region; this does not establish human timing demand.
predictions.remaining_gate: Repeat over continuous phase and attraction regions in spatial and subject-scaled models with an independently identified observer, impact outcomes, and participant holdout.

predictions.statement: Distinct slack mechanisms produce separable multichannel signatures, and any claimed benefit survives matched state, stored energy, work, load, and adverse excitation.
predictions.estimand: Engagement state, transmitted output, stored energy, dissipation, event timing, delivery outcome, local sensitivity, and cross-class separation.
predictions.intervention: Exercise contact disengagement, transmission dead zone, structural preload, biological series compliance, and control deadband one at a time under matched constitutive and forward-delivery controls.
predictions.expected_result: Each mechanism retains a distinguishable signature and any favorable delivery effect persists after preload-energy and task matching.
predictions.falsifier: Signatures become observationally indistinguishable, preload matching reverses the conclusion, or a favorable effect disappears under matched work, load, state, or held-out excitation.
predictions.status_scope: Typed synthetic mechanisms close mechanically, but preload matching reverses open-taut classification, one scalar output nearly confounds two classes, and no global benefit or necessity is supported.
predictions.remaining_gate: Extend each class through longer matched-state, work, and load distributed-grip and shaft delivery, then acquire independent contact, shaft, tendon, activation, and bilateral-wrench measurements.

predictions.statement: Adding bounded scapula-on-ellipsoid mobility increases bilateral fixed-club reachability relative to fixed shoulder centers while retaining explicit nonuniqueness and adverse-span failure.
predictions.estimand: Closure count, residual, solver termination, active-bound count, shoulder-center excursion, constraint rank, coordinate nullity, and adverse-span residual.
predictions.intervention: Solve the same 54 fixed-trunk and fixed-club arm states with fixed shoulder centers and with four bounded scapular coordinates per side.
predictions.expected_result: The mobility surrogate closes more states than the fixed-center control, retains a larger coordinate null space, and fails the deliberately infeasible span.
predictions.falsifier: Reachability does not increase, constraint rank is lost, the adverse span closes, or the apparent gain disappears under independent anatomy and solver controls.
competing_explanations: omitted forearm, wrist, and hand coordinates
predictions.status_scope: The reduced surrogate increases declared reachability and preserves the adverse failure, but only 16 of 54 states also pass solver termination and no anatomical, dynamic, transfer, or strategy claim follows.
predictions.remaining_gate: Reproduce with independently validated articulated shoulders, subject-specific geometry, calibrated grip contact, and paired forward dynamics.

tolerances.source: Current double-pendulum closure, mechanism-ladder invariance, and committed timestep-convergence evidence; each later phase must recalibrate before evaluating its primary outcomes.
